Class J2dGame

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.j2d.J2dGame
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameView
public class J2dGame extends Object implements GameView
The Java2D visualization layer — manages the game window, coordinate conversion, and the rendering pipeline. This is the concrete GameView implementation.

Window: uses a JFrame with an AWT Canvas and a double-buffered BufferStrategy. All drawing goes through render(), which is called once per frame.

Coordinate conversion: the game logic works in game-world units (e.g. 20.0 × 15.0). J2dGame converts these to screen pixels for rendering, and converts screen pixels back to game-world coordinates for mouse input.

Render pipeline: acquire Graphics2D from the buffer strategy, store it so J2d entities can access it via getGraphics2D(), clear the screen and draw map tiles, call render() on all alive entities, draw the HUD, then dispose the graphics and flip the buffer.

J2d entities hold a reference to this J2dGame object so they can call getGraphics2D() and toScreenX(double) / toScreenY(double) inside their render() method.

  • Field Details

    • SPRITE_SCALE

      public static final double SPRITE_SCALE
      Visuele vergroting van sprites t.o.v. hun logische hitbox (puur cosmetisch).

      Het venster schaalt alles al evenredig mee (toScreenWidth(double)), maar de logische groottes (enemy 0.6, projectiel 0.2, ...) ogen klein in een tile. Deze factor tekent de sprite groter en gecentreerd op dezelfde positie, terwijl width/height — en dus collidesWith / gameplay / de bewust kleine flying-hitbox — onaangeroerd blijven. Wordt door de J2d-entities gebruikt in hun render().
